newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 216,400 MT were off 44 percent from the previous week and 48 percent under the 4-week average. Major increases for Mexico (75,500 MT), Japan (67,400 MT), South Korea (56,000 MT), and Greece (23,700 MT) were partially offset by reductions of 24,700 MT for unknown destinations.
Sales of 117,100 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were mostly for unknown destinations (110,000 MT).

Exports of 372,000 MT slid one-quarter below the previous week and one-third below the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (92,500 MT), the Netherlands (69,900 MT), Mexico (65,900 MT), and Taiwan (65,100 MT).
